mintAuthority.summary: scrvUSD is an ERC-4626 savings wrapper over crvUSD; wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting while durable crvUSD mint authority is inherited from the reviewed Curve parent.

controls.label: scrvUSD ERC-4626 wrapper
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25573289, asset() returned crvUSD 0xf939E0A03FB07F59A73314E73794Be0E57ac1b4E. EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were all zero and owner() reverted, leaving no local upgrade-admin or privileged share-mint surface. Wrapper accounting cannot mint crvUSD; durable base authority remains inherited from the reviewed parent.

review.evidence: Re-reviewed at Ethereum block 25573289: asset() is crvUSD 0xf939E0A03FB07F59A73314E73794Be0E57ac1b4E; standard EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots are zero; and owner() reverts. The fixed deposit/share wrapper has no local privileged mint or upgrade path, so its economic cap is deposit-backed and no external supply-versus-reserve reconciliation or named prudential supervisor applies to the wrapper itself. Durable crvUSD authority remains inherited from the reviewed parent profile.
